column1: # The scheduler benchmark's pages: id, url, why it is here. Read by testing/bench/bench.mjs.
# A page is here because it is a JS-heavy app page with logged-out traffic a run can learn from; most are rows
# of testing/corpus/apps.tsv, whose selection tests (a reachable backend, surface behind state the bundle ships)
# and observations are stated there. The replies each page's run fetched are recorded once by `bench.mjs
# record` into a store outside the repository; manifest.json names each page's recording by date and digest.
# control-libs is the instrument control: this repository's own document (testing/corpus/control/serve.mjs,
# served on its 8913 port while recording), whose addresses are known to be reachable natively.
